title: Screening coverage report
description: Parties and grants with their latest screening record, list version and time; any entity lacking a screening record (expected zero).

title: Release fence records
description: Per release: final screening result, list version, fence outcome and any prevented transmissions.

title: List ingestion and freshness log
description: Per list update: publication time, ingestion time, integrity check result, version id, re-screening run, and fail-closed events.

title: Matcher validation report
description: Perturbation suite version, matcher and threshold versions, recall by perturbation type, pass-through test result, approver.

title: Subgroup false-alert report
description: False-alert rates by name subgroup at each change and quarterly.

title: Disposition records
description: Per alert: reviewer, authority, facts compared, decision, timestamps, reuse and expiry of prior dispositions.

title: Blocking, rejection and report packages
description: Block or reject decisions with prepared report data, filing due dates and filing confirmation; annual blocked property report data; second-level review samples.

title: Sanctions record retention verification
description: Retention configuration, hash-chain verification results and legal hold status for sanctions records.

title: Identity regime applicability determinations
description: Register rows per sponsor, role and channel with authority type, owner and counsel status.

title: Monitoring rule definitions and case export log
description: Versioned monitoring rules, generated cases and access log for SAR-support exports.

title: Grantee verification records
description: Per grant: IRS status check results at approval and release, grantee and principal screening, bank change verification records.

title: Tier 2 routing and foreign-grant framework records
description: Signals raised, Tier 2 decisions, sponsor framework enablement records and license reliance versions.

title: Independent testing of sanctions screening coverage and effectiveness
description: Independent tester's report on sanctions list coverage and update latency, matching thresholds, name variants and transliteration, alert disposition evidence and recordkeeping, using seeded test cases.
producer: Independent AML or sanctions testing firm (not engaged)
format: Report or letter (PDF) with scope, period and issuer
notes: Fix pass 2026-11-25 (fix-pass-agent): created for BL-021. Echelon's own OFAC exposure (OBJ-REGULATOR-006) also needs counsel review.

title: Counsel opinion on Echelon's BSA status and independent AML testing of sponsor-facing features
description: Outside counsel's written opinion on whether Echelon is a BSA financial institution or money services business given the final payment model, plus the sponsor's or partner's independent AML test results covering Unbound monitoring and case features.
producer: Outside counsel and the sponsor's independent AML tester (neither engaged)
format: Report or letter (PDF) with scope, period and issuer
notes: Fix pass 2026-11-25 (fix-pass-agent): created for BL-021. Outside counsel retained by Echelon gives a professional opinion, not assurance; the AML test is performed for the sponsor. Examination of Echelon under the Bank Service Company Act would be regulatory-examination evidence if it occurs.
